title: Passed pawns
line: A pawn no pawn can stop, and the extra pawns on one side that make one.

steps.text: On the left, three white pawns face two black ones: a majority. Pushed with care, it makes a pawn no black pawn can stop.
Start with the pawn that has no black pawn in front of it, on its own file. Push it two squares.

wrong.b2b4: Black pushes the pawn in front of it two squares, and that one pawn then holds back two of yours.

also.a2a4: That is fine here too. The safe rule is to start with the pawn that has no pawn in front of it.

steps.hint: It is the pawn nearest the middle of the three.
steps.after: Black's king heads for the middle.

steps.text: Here White pushed the middle pawn first. Black's pawn on b5 now holds back both of White's pawns beside it.
A passed pawn has no enemy pawn in front of it on its file or the files next to it. Tap White's passed pawn.

wrong.g3: Black pawns stand in front of it.
wrong.h3: Black pawns stand in front of it.

steps.after: No pawn can stop it. Only Black's king can.

steps.text: Push it. Black's king has to run after it, and your king is then free to go for the pawns on the other side.

wrong.d4e4: That gives Black's king time to come closer to the pawn.

steps.after: Black pushes a pawn on the other side.
Black's king stops the pawn, far from its own pawns.

summary: More pawns on one side can make a passed pawn. Push first the pawn with no enemy pawn in front of it.
